title: Score cost tooltip is a 121-word operator memo that contradicts its label
body:
## Summary
costLabel (lib/musicClient.ts:157-183) forwards the server's pricing note verbatim as the native `title=` on the Score step's cost line; on today's live branch that title is 121 words, opens '1s of audio' under a label reading '13s of audio · unpriced', and ends with operator instructions ('WHAT WOULD FILL THIS ROW: render one cue... Do not copy a figure from a blog post').

## Description
Measured with tsx against HEAD: costLabel(priceTable().perSecond, 13) -> text '13s of audio · unpriced', title 121 words starting '1s of audio, at an undeclared rate...'. The '1s' is because /api/music/pricing quotes `estimatePerSecond()` = priceCall({op:'generate', seconds:1}) (lib/music/pricing.ts:256-258) and the note bakes the seconds in (:186-192), then appends row.source - the 90-word 'Never measured here... this repo has never rendered a cue...' (:105-106). Other branches: null -> 'Asking /api/music/pricing what a render costs.' (a route path, subject the app); 'unknown' -> 31 words of the app explaining itself; credits -> '...no USD conversion is declared in this repo.'. Rendered at app/_phases/score/ScoreSpotting.tsx:1062 `title={estimate.title}` and :1105 `title={settled?.title}`. check:narration's title ratchet cannot see any of it: it reads literal attributes only (pipeline/check-narration.mjs header), and this is a runtime value - exactly the relocation the gate was built against, through the one door it admits it cannot watch.

## Flow
- Score step -> hover the cost under 'Render cue' -> a paragraph about how to measure ElevenLabs credits and which blog posts not to trust, describing a 1-second render.

## Expected impact
The cost line's disclosure says the work (seconds, unit, that no rate is measured) in a few words and agrees with the label; the operator memo stays where it belongs, in lib/music/pricing.ts and the /api/music/pricing JSON for agents.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the tooltip on a price should state the price facts for THIS render, not instruct the developer
Before: live-branch title 121 words, seconds disagree with label (1 vs 13); 4 of 6 costLabel branches carry a route path, repo path or 'this repo' (null, unknown narration, credits, unpriced via note)
After: every branch's title <= 25 words, contains no '/api/', 'lib/', 'this repo' or imperative to the operator, and its seconds equal the text's; unpriced title e.g. '13s · billed in credits · rate not measured'
Method: probe - tsx run of costLabel over priceTable().perSecond and null/'unknown'; word counts and substring checks
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: npx tsx: costLabel(priceTable().perSecond,13) -> {text:'13s of audio · unpriced', title: 121 words '1s of audio, at an undeclared rate...'}; costLabel(null,13).title = 'Asking /api/music/pricing what a render costs.'; costLabel('unknown',13).title = 31 words; lib/musicClient.ts:162,166-168,176,181 (title: price.note); lib/music/pricing.ts:105-106 source, :186-192 unpriced note, :256-258 seconds:1; ScoreSpotting.tsx:1062, :1105.
verify: In costLabel build every title from the quote's structured fields (seconds passed in, basis, credits/usd) and stop returning price.note: null -> '' ; unknown -> 'price table unreachable'; unpriced -> `${seconds}s · billed in credits · rate not measured`; credits branch keeps the phrase 'no USD conversion is declared' (asserted at music-budget.probe.spec.ts:359) but drops 'in this repo'. Extend tests/golden-path/music-budget.probe.spec.ts with a test that, for [null, 'unknown', priceCall generate/music_v2 13s, priceCall plan, the withRate fixture at :351, a usd fixture], asserts title word count <= 25, !/\/api\/|lib\/|this repo|do not/i.test(title), and that any '<n>s' in title equals the seconds argument - red on HEAD (121 words, '1s', '/api/'). Existing assertions :336 (title contains 'credit') and :359 must stay green. Do NOT edit lib/music/pricing.ts notes - :139 asserts the note names lib/music/pricing.ts for agents.

title: Sound lab rail shows music tallies under SFX until the new read lands
body:
## Summary
Switching music -> sfx re-keys the tally load but keeps the previous kind's counts on the rail until (and unless) the SFX read resolves; a read that never returns leaves music's '12 to judge' drawn beside the SFX module indefinitely.

## Description
app/playground/PlaygroundView.tsx:88-89: `useLoadFor(`${kind}:${version}`, () => readTallies(kind), setTallies)` and the hook's return (hydrated-for-this-key, app/_phases/_shared/useLoadFor.ts:85-115) is discarded. useLoadFor only calls apply on resolution (:101-108), so `tallies` keeps the old kind's numbers through the switch while the modules below remount with key={kind} (:138-142) - the rail and the panel briefly (or permanently, on a hung fetch: lib/sound/client.ts call() has no timeout) describe different kinds. The file's own rule (:53-54) is 'a count the store could not answer is null and its tally is not drawn - never a 0 standing in for unknown'; a different kind's count standing in for unknown breaks it worse than a 0 would.

## Flow
- Sound lab -> Triage shows '7 to judge' for music -> click 'sfx' -> SFX list loads with 2 unjudged -> rail still says 7 until listTakes for sfx returns.

## Expected impact
The rail never shows a count for a kind the panel is not showing; loading reads as 'no tally' exactly as failure already does.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the tally beside a tab must describe the kind I am looking at
Before: after a kind switch, tallies drawn for the wrong kind until resolution: 3 of 3 (unjudged, finalized, hunts); on a hung read: indefinitely
After: 0 of 3: tallies carry the kind they were read for and are drawn only when it equals the current kind; a same-kind refresh (version++) keeps the old numbers (no blink)
Method: probe - source ratchet on PlaygroundView.tsx plus a walked render: useLoadFor applies only on resolve; tallies state is not reset on key change
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: app/playground/PlaygroundView.tsx:53-54 (rule), :88-89 (useLoadFor return discarded, no reset on kind change), :97-123 (tallies spread into tabs), :138-142 (modules key={kind}); app/_phases/_shared/useLoadFor.ts:99-112; lib/sound/client.ts:26-41 (no timeout).
verify: Make the Tallies state `{ kind: SoundKind | null; unjudged; finalized; hunts }`, have readTallies return the kind it read, and gate each tab's `tally` spread on `tallies.kind === kind` (in addition to the existing != null checks). Probe tests/golden-path/sound-lab-tallies.probe.spec.ts: stripComments(app/playground/PlaygroundView.tsx) matches /tallies\.kind\s*===\s*kind/ and readTallies' return includes `kind` - red on HEAD. npm run typecheck green.

title: Kind switch claims ARIA radio semantics with no arrow keys or roving tabindex
body:
## Summary
KindSwitch (app/playground/PlaygroundView.tsx:153-176) marks two <button>s role="radio" in a role="radiogroup", which tells a screen reader 'radio button, 1 of 2' and promises arrow-key selection with a single tab stop; it implements neither - both buttons are tab stops and arrows do nothing.

## Description
No onKeyDown, no tabIndex management (:159-171). It is the same mis-promise UserMenu.tsx:13-19 records removing for role=menu ('promises arrow-key navigation... and it had neither'). The design system already ships the honest version: components/ui/Field.tsx:218-270 <Segmented> renders native <input type=radio> inside labels (arrow keys and one tab stop for free) with has-[:focus-visible] ring on the label. Segmented's visible <legend> would add a caption to the rail, so the in-place fix is Segmented's technique, not the component: sr-only native radios inside the existing pill labels. Siblings with the same pattern (outside this context, unmapped): app/playground/triage/index.tsx:61, app/playground/triage/Strengths.tsx:121.

## Flow
- Screen-reader user tabs to 'music' -> hears 'radio button, checked, 1 of 2' -> presses Right Arrow as the role instructs -> nothing happens.

## Expected impact
The control behaves as it announces itself; keyboard users get one tab stop and arrow switching like every native radio set in the app.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a control announced as a radio group should respond to arrow keys
Before: role="radio" buttons without arrow handling or roving tabindex in this context: 2 (1 group); tab stops for the group: 2
After: 0 role="radio" in PlaygroundView.tsx; 2 native <input type="radio" name=…> (sr-only) inside the existing pill <label>s, ring via has-[:focus-visible]:outline-2; tab stops: 1; visual unchanged
Method: probe - source ratchet over PlaygroundView.tsx; parity read against Field.tsx Segmented
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: app/playground/PlaygroundView.tsx:155 role="radiogroup", :162-163 role="radio" aria-checked on <button>, no onKeyDown in :153-176; components/ui/Field.tsx:218-270 Segmented (native radios); UserMenu.tsx:13-19 precedent; siblings triage/index.tsx:61, triage/Strengths.tsx:121.
verify: Rewrite KindSwitch as a <fieldset> (or role=radiogroup div kept) of two <label>s each holding `<input type="radio" className="sr-only" name={useId()} checked={on} onChange={() => onKind(k)} data-testid={`kind-${k}`} />` plus the existing pill span; move the on/off classes to the label and add `has-[:focus-visible]:outline-2 has-[:focus-visible]:outline-offset-2` (mirror Field.tsx Segmented's non-almanac branch). Keep data-testid kind-music/kind-sfx (UAT/live lanes click them - a click on the input still fires onChange). Probe tests/golden-path/sound-lab-kind-switch.probe.spec.ts: stripComments(PlaygroundView.tsx) has 0 matches of /role="radio"/ and >=1 of /type="radio"/ - red on HEAD. Photograph `playground` via pipeline/cx-capture.mjs to confirm the pill is visually unchanged.

lens_checked.visual-craft: PlaygroundView.tsx KindSwitch pill classes vs TabRail ACTIVE/IDLE tokens (components/ui/signal/TabRail.tsx: ACTIVE border-cyan-400/40 bg-cyan-400/10 vs KindSwitch bg-cyan-400/15 + glow - a near-twin, below finding threshold); page.tsx Suspense fallback={null} under AuthGate/StudioFrame
lens_checked.ux-reviewer: module rail URL state (?m= ?kind=, setParam replace with scroll:false), FlashLine mount, tabpanel aria-label={active} (lowercase id instead of the tab label - same pattern in CalendarView.tsx:88, FoundryView.tsx:406; needs TabRail tab ids, ui-shell territory)
lens_checked.state-coverage: readTallies zero/failure/never-returns per tab: zero -> '0' neutral tally, failure -> null -> not drawn, never-returns -> not drawn on first load but stale across kind (filed)
lens_checked.copy-auditor: costLabel all 6 branches measured; lib/music/errors.ts + elevenlabs.ts MusicError messages (real errors, exempt); SpendButton (app/playground/shared/price.tsx) drops cost.title entirely - no narration reaches the Sound lab
lens_checked.accessibility-checker: KindSwitch radio semantics; FlashLine aria-live (app/playground/shared/shell.tsx:53, unmapped) counted in ai-orchestration's live-region census rather than filed twice

lens_no_surface.mobile-specialist: Sound lab is a desktop workbench (StudioFrame shell, no narrow layout intent in PlaygroundView)
